subject: Rerank pilot fit summary and canary design
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Becker <tom.becker@shopcart.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-15T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + recommended next steps (rerank pilot)

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed path forward focused on model fit and a light canary A/B so you can validate impact without risking ranking regressions.

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary goal: increase relevance for product search results for mid-tail queries while preserving click-through on top queries.
- Constraints: 99th perc latency target ~120ms at p50 for web search, and no more than 1% negative regression on high-traffic queries.
- Data: you confirmed a 6-week sample of search logs + labeled relevance judgments for ~12k queries.

Redwood recommended model candidates (based on our offline fit runs):
1) redwood/rerank-medium-v2 (float16) — best overall NDCG lift across head+mid (baseline: ShopCart current model).
2) redwood/rerank-small-quant — lower latency, small accuracy drop but useful for global traffic.
3) redwood/rerank-medium-quant-fallback — quantized variant for burst capacity and fallback.

Key offline metrics (attached eval_results_ndcg_mrr_v1.csv):
- NDCG@10: +4.1% (redwood/rerank-medium-v2 vs baseline)
- MRR: +3.3%
- Tail (queries outside top 20 freq): NDCG uplift ~6.0%

Artifacts attached: prompt_set_shopcart_v1.jsonl (example prompts / candidate templates), eval_results_ndcg_mrr_v1.csv (score breakdown), and a short canary runbook draft.

Risks & quality controls we recommend:
- Monitor NDCG and MRR per-segment (head/mid/tail) and set automatic rollback on sustained >1% degradation in head queries for 30m window.
- Token-level cost vs latency trade: medium-v2 increases avg p50 by ~18ms in our infra profile; quantify in your env during canary.

Suggested next steps:
- Your team: provide a small sampling endpoint for live traffic (we can accept a mirrored stream or a 1% sampled route).
- Redwood: provision a 2-week canary plan with 0.5% -> 5% traffic ramp and a real-time dashboard.
- Agree success criteria: NDCG@10 lift >=2.5% and MRR uplift >=1.5% with <1% negative head regression.

I'll loop Aditya for the technical runbook and Marissa for ops coordination. Would Thursday at 11am PT work for a 30-min tactical planning call?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment stubs: eval_results_ndcg_mrr_v1.csv (csv), prompt_set_shopcart_v1.jsonl (jsonl), canary_runbook.pdf (pdf)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-16T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + recommended next steps (rerank pilot)

Tom / team — adding a few technical notes from the eval and a short excerpt of the scoring breakdown that may help your infra and SRE teams plan.

Technical highlights:
- Offline eval used your 6-week sample with 5-fold cross validation; we held out top 2k queries for stability checks.
- We included a precision@1 and CTR proxy to ensure head preservation. The medium-v2 model had the best balance of NDCG uplift (+4.1%) and precision@1 delta (+0.6%).
- Latency profile (our dedicated infra estimate): p50 ~118ms, p90 ~210ms for medium-v2; quant variant p50 ~95ms, p90 ~170ms.

Snippet of the CSV (top lines):
query_segment,model,ndcg10_delta,mrr_delta,precision1_delta,avg_p50_ms
all,redwood/rerank-medium-v2,+4.1%,+3.3%,+0.6%,118
all,redwood/rerank-small-quant,+1.8%,+1.0%,-0.1%,95

Operational notes:
- We recommend starting with a mirrored traffic test for 24-48h to validate latency and any unexpected errors before ramping traffic.
- Canary rollout plan (draft below) includes a quick rollback hook based on error rates and head-query NDCG.

I'll bring the runbook PDF to the planning call and can demo the dashboard metrics.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Tom Becker <tom.becker@shopcart.com>

Date: 2026-08-18T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + recommended next steps (rerank pilot)

Thanks Neha — this is helpful. A few quick questions from our sides:

1) The latency numbers look reasonable, but our production p50 is currently ~70ms. If we add ~40ms we risk impacting UX on search page loads. Can you confirm an end-to-end estimate including network overhead on our us-west-2 region?
2) For the labeled judgments: are the prompt/templates you used available so our data team can inspect labeling/schema drift risk?
3) Canary duration and rollback thresholds — we prefer short canaries but need statistically significant lift. Can you propose a specific AB schedule (sample sizes / duration) and the alerting windows?

We can do the planning call on Thursday 11am PT. Please include an SRE contact so we can talk routing/mirroring options.

Tom Becker

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Becker <tom.becker@shopcart.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + recommended next steps (rerank pilot)

Tom — great questions. Below is a concrete canary A/B proposal and the additional artifacts you asked for. Happy to walk through on Thursday.

1) End-to-end latency estimate
- We profiled medium-v2 in us-west-2 with realistic network egress: estimated p50 end-to-end ~105–125ms depending on routing (includes ~10–20ms avg network overhead). Quant variant p50 ~85–100ms. We'll provide a short mirroring test to validate.

2) Labeling / prompt artifacts
- Attached prompt_set_shopcart_v1.jsonl contains the actual templates used for ranking context + relevance label mapping. We also included a README in the Drive link describing the schema and labeling heuristics.

3) Canary AB schedule (recommended)
- Phase A: Mirrored validation — 48h of mirrored traffic to validate latency and error rates (no user impact). Success: error rate <0.05% and p50 within +40ms of baseline.
- Phase B: Controlled AB — 0.5% traffic for 24h (sanity), 1% for 48h (stat check), 5% for 7 days (full validation).
- Statistical goals: detect NDCG@10 lift >=2.5% with 95% confidence. We estimate needing ~100k queries in test exposure to hit that significance for your traffic profile (we'll calculate exact sample size after seeing daily query counts).
- Rollback criteria (auto): sustained head-segment NDCG drop >1% for a 30m window OR error rate spike to >0.2% OR p90 latency increase >50% over baseline for 15m.

4) Telemetry & dashboards
- We'll publish per-minute NDCG, MRR, CTR-proxy, latency p50/p90, and error rates. We'll also surface top-k queries with largest delta for manual inspection.

5) Fallback strategy
- Immediate: auto-switch to redwood/rerank-medium-quant-fallback if error or latency thresholds breached. Longer-term: gradient rollout with traffic-weighted combination.

Next steps for Thursday 11am PT call:
- ShopCart: confirm SRE attendee and share an endpoint for mirrored traffic (or a forwarding plan).
- Redwood: finalize runbook, provide sample-size calc, and provision canary infra.

I've attached the runbook PDF (canary_runbook.pdf) and included links to the Drive + HubSpot deal. If you're comfortable I can kick off a mirrored job as soon as we have the endpoint.

See you on Thursday — I'll send the calendar invite with the agenda.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
